summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its proxy statement, proxy card, and 2025 annual report for the 2026 annual meeting of stockholders scheduled for October 8, 2026. The meeting agenda includes electing one Class I Director and ratifying Ernst Young (Hellas) as independent auditors. This is a routine annual meeting notice with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews. The registrant is the issuer acting as filer, and the filing contains no deal terms. What to watch: none; this is standard corporate governance reporting.
